result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor content truncation problem with a restaurant name.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears to be missing the last letter 'n', displaying as 'Tokumaru Rame' followed by what looks like a truncation, possibly due to the rating/review badge overlapping or the text being cut off by the layout.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name text container has enough width to display the full name, or use ellipsis truncation consistently so it's clear the text is intentionally cut. Check that the star rating element on the right doesn't cause the name to clip mid-character.
